finding: Current Evidence Readiness Matrix blocks all experiments only when shadowIntegrity.status is exactly RESEARCH_DATA_GAP. Count thresholds can otherwise yield DESCRIPTIVE_READY while newer evidence firewalls are UNKNOWN/BLOCKED because those states are not inputs to researchEvidenceReadinessMatrix.
notComposedIntoMatrix: equal-date weighting firewall for R01/R04/R05/R07 and I01-I07
market/source/vintage coverage beyond simple external row/date counts

separateGovernanceMaturity.positive: researchGovernanceMaturity separately checks legacy promotion gate, full snapshots/dates/years/regimes, Shadow D5 count, regime days, exact RESEARCH_DATA_GAP, redundancy REVIEW_REQUIRED and cost sample count; cluster wrapper can block fragile mature incremental contrasts.
separateGovernanceMaturity.gap: It also does not consume the newer lineage, reader-completeness, outcome-CA/session, equal-date, target-provenance or pool-matching firewalls. UNKNOWN statuses are not universally fail-closed.

risk: DESCRIPTIVE_READY currently means only that the experiment-specific count checks passed under the legacy integrity flag. It must not be interpreted as evidence-quality-ready or promotion-ready.
requiredFailClosedContract: Every experiment declares required firewalls and accepted states.
UNKNOWN/BLOCKED required firewall => EVIDENCE_QUALITY_BLOCKED, never READY.

Promotion eligibility is logical AND of count maturity, PIT/generation lineage, population/cohort integrity, outcome quality, reader completeness, estimator/date weighting, source coverage, purge/OOS, cost, redundancy/incremental and regime/coverage requirements applicable to that experiment.
R08 may use its paired equal-date estimator; row-weighted byEngine remains descriptive.
No generic global flag may certify experiment-specific target provenance or pool matching.

engineering.implementationBoundary: Changing dashboard/readiness computation in Worker/shared runtime is Class B proposal-first unless isolated research-only module with no Formal dependency is proven.

exactNext: Map R01-R08/I01-I07 to an explicit required-firewall matrix with per-experiment applicability and fail-closed accepted states. Then audit whether an isolated Class-A readiness composer can be tested without Worker/runtime integration; if yes prepare prototype/tests only, otherwise freeze Class-B proposal.
